svg.title: From the last disc, scan four directions both ways and add one for the disc itself
svg.desc: Four copies of the 5 by 5 window around (2,2). Horizontal: no red neighbours, length 1. Vertical: Yellow below, empty above, length 1. Diagonal: two red down-left, one red up-right, length 4, a win. Anti-diagonal: one red down-right, length 2.
svg.text: the four lines through the last disc (2, 2), each scanned both ways
itself + one way + the other way; stop at the first cell that is not Red
